endpoints.name: CreateFinancialQuarter
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new financial quarter with name, financial year ID, and date range.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates financial quarter. Validates quarter name non-empty and unique. Fetches financial year by ID.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Quarter name non-empty and unique. Financial year exists.
business_logic.validations: Token validation. ModelState valid. Quarter name non-empty. No duplicate quarter name.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Financial quarter with this name already exists.
message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

idempotency.notes: Duplicate check prevents re-creation. Second call fails.

endpoints.short_description: Create a new financial quarter with name, financial year ID, and date range.
endpoints.detailed_description: Create a new financial quarter with name, financial year ID, and date range. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFinancialQuarters.GetFinancialYearById, IFinancialQuarters.IsFinancialQuartersDuplicateAsync, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: FinancialQuarters: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Financial quarter name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.quarter_name)]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.business_rule_errors: Financial quarter with this name already exists. [when dupcheck]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create a new financial quarter with name, financial year ID, and date range.
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.side_effects: Quarter updated. Audit log created with old/new values.
